text:
maria: heads up — need to lock capacity for the Redwood demo on Apr 2. We need 8h of non-preemptible H100 (single AZ if possible). Is there a way to request a hard reservation with the vendor, or do we have to stitch soft-reserves + fallback?

sam: short answer: vendor only guarantees via PO for hard reserves. soft-reserve exists but can be reclaimed. can check current availability for that window. do you have exact hours/timezone and tenant id?

maria: thx. window is 2026-04-02 10:00-18:00 UTC, tenant demo-redwood. demo is latency-sensitive so preemptible fallback is risky.

alan: procurement note — PO lead time is ~5 business days for hard-reserve on that SKU (depends on vendor invoicing). if you need immediate guarantee we can put a short-term PO and short-contract addendum. will need cost center + approver.

jess: infra note — we can also implement an automated fallback that routes to dedicated a100s in same region with slightly higher p99. trouble is cross-AZ egress/latency if we span zones. i recommend a canary plan: reserve soft-hold + pre-warm a100 fallback, and run a quick tail-latency test.

priya: oncall check — if we go soft-reserve + fallback, update the routing policy:
```
routing:
  primary: h100-nonpreemptible
  fallback:
    - a100-dedicated
    - h100-preemptible
  max-fallback-latency-ms: 120
```
apply to demo-redwood route. also confirm whether the billing hold on demo tenant will block reservation.

maria: billing is clear for demo-redwood (no holds). if procurement needs approver i can loop in finance. prefer hard-reserve if procurement can turn it around.

alan: i'll start the PO draft now. can you post the exact line item text? vendor prefers: "1x H100 non-preemptible reservation, us-west2b, 8h window, 2026-04-02". sending to vendor PM after finance signoff.

sam: running a quick capacity snapshot, pinging vendor for confirmation. infra-bot will post latest counts.

infra-bot: capacity-snapshot for requested window (approx):
```
h100-nonpreemptible/us-west2b: 4 available
a100-dedicated/us-west2b: 12 available
h100-preemptible/us-west2b: 28 available
```
note: numbers are point-in-time and may change on vendor side.

jess: if vendor confirms <4 we should gatemark the demo and enable canary with a100s. i can schedule a 30-min latency smoke at 09:30 UTC that morning. anyone object?

maria: good plan — no objections. alan please cc finance and vendor PM. sam, keep us posted. :thumbsup:

sam: will update thread once vendor acked or if we need to flip to fallback. expected vendor reply in ~2 business hours.

alan: draft PO created, awaiting finance approver (cc @finance). sending vendor terms in parallel.

priya: noted — i'll add the route change to the demo runbook and set alert on fallback rate >5%.

maria: thanks team. moving to async; i'll create a short RFC with the reservation text + runbook link.
